title: Income Tax Department: ITR-6 Offline Utility for AY 2026-27 Now Available!
content:
# Income Tax Department: ITR-6 Offline Utility for AY 2026-27 Now Available!

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Department ne Assessment Year (AY) 2026-27 (Financial Year 2025-26) ke liye ITR-6 ki offline utility ab filing ke liye available kar di hai. Taxpayers ke liye yeh ek suvidha hai taaki woh time par apni compliances poori kar sakein.

*   **Availability:** The offline utility for filing Income Tax Return (ITR-6) for Assessment Year 2026-27 (FY 2025-26) was made available on August 20, 2026, on the official e-filing portal.
*   **Applicability:** ITR-6 form is specifically designed for companies, excluding those that claim exemption under Section 11 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (i.e., income from charitable or religious property).
*   **Key Due Dates (for reference):**
    *   For most companies whose accounts are subject to audit, the due date for filing ITR-6 is October 31, 2026.
    *   For companies required to furnish a transfer pricing report, the due date is typically November 30, 2026.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official ITR-6 Offline Utility for AY 2026-27 here](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/downloads/income-tax-returns)
